title: I am disappointed.
text: I am disappointed.. The major reason for the 2 star rating is quality: out of half of dozen cups I checked, there maybe two can be said okay, the rest have different issues such as uneven base, bumps around the edge ... to me, it is defective. The probably explains the lower price, but I would rather get Liberty 4 3/4 for that matter. All in all, I am disappointed.
